answer: A robust Sybil resistance mechanism for an AI agent economy requires each synthetic identity to stake verifiable computational collateral, forming a decentralized atlas of provenance. This staked asset acts as a cryptographic jetty, raising the marginal cost of forging parallel agents to an unbreachable threshold. Crucially, agents must occupy a reputation ledge, meaning they must pass continuous behavioral attestation before transacting. This ensures that identity is earned, not fabricated, neutralizing the economic asymmetry of mass forgery.
